title: Irugapatru
desc: A marriage counsellor and her partner, along with two other couples, navigate the trials and tribulations of a love relationship.

title: Raame Aandalum Raavane Aandalum
desc: An impoverished rural couple look for their prized bulls, which have gone missing. However, they receive little help from a community that is apathetic to their plight.

title: Maaran
desc: Mathimaran, an honest journalist, exposes a fraud by Pazhani, a politician. As a result, it lands his career in trouble, while also threatening his family's safety.

title: Kadhale Kadhale
desc: Hari, a happy-go-lucky DJ, is not a stranger to rejection. But when he meets the beautiful Sailaja, he goes out of his way to make sure she reciprocates his feelings.

title: Saakini Daakini
desc: Two police trainees set out on a dangerous mission in order to investigate the kidnapping of a girl from a nightclub when they fail to get the police's help.

title: Nadungaadhey Illathil Pei
desc: A man poses as a tantric to earn money for his love interest's orphanage. However, things take a turn when a ghost begins to follow him after he pretends to perform an exorcism.

title: Kalyana Vaibhogam
desc: A man with strong traditional values falls in love with a woman, and they decide to get married, until the groom and the bride's father have a difference of opinion about marriage.

title: Yaar Enda Mani-Evade Subrahm
desc: Driven by unrelenting ambition, Nani sets out on a transformative quest to the Himalayas, compelled by the tragic loss of his childhood friend and a series of daunting challenges.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Jaanu
desc: Ram and Jaanu are childhood sweethearts who meet at their school reunion after nearly two decades. Although initially awkward, they soon start recollecting their past and resolve their differences.

title: Dhoni
desc: Inspired by Mahendra Singh Dhoni, a 14-year-old boy dreams of becoming a cricketer. However, his father, a government employee, has other plans.

title: World Famous Lover
desc: An anthology of four inspiring love stories that showcase the diverse perspectives towards love that are prevalent among the different strata of human society.

title: Ethir Neechal
desc: When a man's deception about his real name is revealed, he is compelled to join a marathon to prove himself to his lover.

title: Velaikkaran
desc: Arivazhagan, a slum dweller, works in a large food company. However, when he realises that they adulterate the food, he strives to fight them.

title: Kadaikutty Singam
desc: Gunasingam, a rich farmer, lives a humble life with his family. However, things take a turn when he falls in love with the most beautiful woman in the village.

title: Pechi
desc: Accompanied by a guide, five friends go on a trekking trip to a haunted forest and despite being warned, they enter a restricted area that harbours an evil spirit.
